{{Hatnote|This page is printed Decipher cards plus original Virtual Sets 1–2 (2002 PDF slips). It is not current [[Virtual Set 2]] and not [[Premiere to Virtual Set 3]].}}
'''Premiere - Original VS2''' is the constructed pool of printed Decipher cards through [[Theed Palace]] plus original [[Players Committee]] Virtual Sets 1–2.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards2.pdf VirtualCards2.pdf], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 24 October 2007); mirror: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards2.pdf res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks]</ref> [[Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour|Virtual Set 2]] became tournament-legal on 1 June 2002.<ref name="vs2002">[[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]</ref> The short name '''POVS2''' redirects here.
